# socR

[![R-universe
status](https://danielruss.r-universe.dev/badges/socR)](https://danielruss.r-universe.dev/socR)

[![Join the chat at
https://gitter.im/daniel_socR/community](https://badges.gitter.im/daniel_socR/community.svg)](https://gitter.im/daniel_socR/community?utm_source=badge&utm_medium=badge&utm_campaign=pr-badge&utm_content=badge)

An R package used to analyze SOCcer results

socR is centered around codingsystems and crosswalking between
codingsystems. It’s still in development so it is likely to change
often.

[Have a problem?](https://github.com/danielruss/socR/issues)

## How to install

if you don’t have the devtools package installed, install that first…

    install.packages("devtools)

then

    library(devtools)
    install_github("danielruss/socR")

# Package index

## All functions

- [`as_codingsystem()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/as_codingsystem.md)
  : Create a coding system from a data frame
- [`bin_center()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/bin_center.md)
  : Bin Score and Assign center value
- [`codeJobHistory()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codeJobHistory.md)
  : Auto-code job results with SOCcer using via the soccer API
- [`codes()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codes.md) :
  get the codes for a crosswalk,
- [`codesAgree()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codesAgree.md)
  : Check if codes agree with reviewer
- [`codingsystem()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codingsystem.md)
  : constructor create a coding system S3 class
- [`select(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codingsystem_dplyr.md)
  [`filter(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codingsystem_dplyr.md)
  [`mutate(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codingsystem_dplyr.md)
  [`arrange(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codingsystem_dplyr.md)
  [`as_tibble(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codingsystem_dplyr.md)
  [`count(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/codingsystem_dplyr.md)
  : Use Coding system with dplyr
- [`combine_crosswalks()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/combine_crosswalks.md)
  : Combine two crosswalks to produce a new crosswalk
- [`createMultiHotEncoder()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/createMultiHotEncoder.md)
  : creates a multihot encoder from a list of labels
- [`crosswalk()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/crosswalk.md)
  : Use the concordance table (crosswalk) to convert from one coding
  system to another.
- [`crosswalk_columns()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/crosswalk_columns.md)
  : Crosswalk multiple columns in a tibble/data frame
- [`dim(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/dim.codingsystem.md)
  : Dimensions of an Object
- [`extend_standard_soc1980_codes()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/extend_standard_soc1980_codes.md)
  : Extended SOC 1980 codes
- [`format(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/format.codingsystem.md)
  : formats a codingsystem
- [`get_codes()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/get_codes.md)
  : Get a list of codes from a coding system
- [`head(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/head.codingsystem.md)
  : Return the First or Last Parts of an Object
- [`is.codingsystem()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/is.codingsystem.md)
  : checks if an object is a coding system
- [`is.xwalk()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/is.xwalk.md)
  : checks if an object is a crosswalk
- [`is_url()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/is_url.md) :
  Check if a value is a url by looking for the http(s):// .Works with
  vectors...
- [`is_valid()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/is_valid.md)
  : Check if a set of codes are valid for a coding system
- [`level()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/level.md) :
  Get the code Level
- [`load_socassign_db()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/load_socassign_db.md)
  : load_socassign_db
- [`lookup_code()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/lookup_code.md)
  : Look up code
- [`make_code_str()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/make_code_str.md)
  : convert a list column of codes to vector of string for display
- [`name()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/name.md) :
  Returns the user assigned name of the coding system
- [`noc2011_4digit`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/noc2011_4digit.md)
  : noc2011 4 digit classification system
- [`noc2011_all`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/noc2011_all.md)
  : noc2011 4 digit classification system
- [`print(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/print.codingsystem.md)
  : prints a codingsystem
- [`soc1980_all`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/soc1980_all.md)
  : SOC 1980 complete classification system
- [`soc1980_detailed`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/soc1980_detailed.md)
  : Detailed SOC 1980 classification system
- [`soc1980_extended`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/soc1980_extended.md)
  : Extended SOC 1980 complete classification system
- [`soc2010_6digit`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/soc2010_6digit.md)
  : soc2010 6 digit classification system
- [`soc2010_all`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/soc2010_all.md)
  : Complete SOC 2010 classification system
- [`soc2018_all`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/soc2018_all.md)
  : Complete SOC 2018 classification system
- [`split_data()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/split_data.md)
  : Split data
- [`standardize_soc1980_codes()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/standardize_soc1980_codes.md)
  : Standardize US SOC 1980 codes
- [`tail(`*`<codingsystem>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/tail.codingsystem.md)
  : Return the First or Last Parts of an Object
- [`to_level()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/to_level.md)
  : to_level
- [`to_list_column()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/to_list_column.md)
  : Create a list column from multiple columns
- [`valid_code()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/valid_code.md)
  [`is_valid_6digit_soc2010()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/valid_code.md)
  [`is_valid_soc1980()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/valid_code.md)
  [`is_most_detailed_soc1980()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/valid_code.md)
  [`is_valid_extended_soc1980()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/valid_code.md)
  [`is_most_detailed_extended_soc1980()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/valid_code.md)

- [`xwalk()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/xwalk.md) :
  xwalk class constructor
- [`filter(`*`<xwalk>`*`)`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/xwalk_dplyr.md)

- [`xwalk_entropy()`](https://danielruss.github.io/socR/reference/xwalk_entropy.md)
  : Calculates the Shannon entropy for a Crosswalk
